messages:
lee: Quick report: JS SDK 1.3.0 isn't sending sampling params to /v1/generate. I passed top_k and top_p but gateway only received model+prompt. Repro below.

lee: repro snippets:
```bash
# REST (works)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","topK":40,"topP":0.95,"prompt":"test"}'
# JS SDK (no-op sampling)
node -e "const {Client}=require('redwood'); new Client().generate({model:'rwd-3b',top_k:40,top_p:0.95,prompt:'test'}).then(console.log)"
```

nina: thanks, good catch. looks like the serializer drops unknown snake_case keys. we introduced a strict whitelist in the refactor.

omar: also noticed retry mismatch: SDK stopped including X-Redwood-Retry so transient 429s are not retried by gateway. customers see immediate errors instead of graceful retries.

nina: plan: (1) patch serializer to map snake_case sampling params to camelCase; (2) restore X-Redwood-Retry header in HTTP client; (3) add e2e that asserts non-greedy outputs when sampling params set.

lee: found one customer thread reporting decreased diversity after upgrade. worth a patch release.

omar: i'll open PRs: #4501 (js param map + tests), #4502 (retry header + middleware tests). tagging @ci-bot to run starter-app e2e.

ci-bot: CI queued for PRs #4501,#4502. Running starter-app integration.

nina: target patch release 1.3.1 in ~48h once PRs pass. we'll add a short migration note in docs.

lee: thanks all. adding a follow-up to add telemetry when snake_case is used so we can measure impact.
